# CartGenerator 0.5.2 macOS Hotfix
Release date: 2026-10-07 Platform: macOS arm64 Distribution: ad-hoc-signed direct-download DMG (not notarized)
## Artifact
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.2-macOS-arm64.dmg` - Size: 258 MB - SHA-256: `30a13e82a53c29500d2a4967b28cf51fe680bdb85c3b58613b77baf0375aa990`
## Critical crash fix
- Fixed a native crash that could occur immediately after starting cart processing. - Playwright synchronous browser operations now run on one persistent Python-owned thread for the full browser session. - This prevents its greenlet runtime from being reused across separate Qt callback thread states. - Browser startup, job creation, cart inspection, item processing, pause/resume, recovery, and shutdown now share the same serialized runtime owner. - Cart planning and TargetSite interaction rules are unchanged.
## Recovery after the 0.5.1 crash
0.5.1 persisted recovery state before the crash. After installing 0.5.2, inspect the current TargetSite cart before selecting whether to retry or skip the interrupted item. Do not assume an interrupted cart operation failed solely because the app closed.
## Installation
1. Open the DMG. 2. Drag `CartGenerator.app` to `Applications`, replacing 0.5.1 if prompted. 3. Because this direct-download build is not Apple-notarized, Control-click the app, choose **Open**, and confirm the warning on first launch. 4. Existing CartGenerator application data and the dedicated Chromium profile are retained.
## Verification performed
- 225 Python tests passed, including persistent-runtime ownership regression tests. - 6 Cloudflare Worker tests passed. - Python compilation and source diff checks passed. - Real Playwright Chromium was exercised across four separate calls on one persistent Python thread using local HTML only. - No live cart mutation was performed as part of hotfix verification.
## Source archive
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.2-source.tar.gz` - SHA-256: `8a8c992281083190e0356eb7d0ee276f504c8f0d5e6eda101347dabea56c8d16`
The archive excludes Git internals, virtual environments, generated binaries, release artifacts, release-note metadata, diagnostics, local environment files, and caches.
## Automatic updates
The EdDSA-signed Sparkle feed and update ZIP are published from `52274b/CartGenerator-Releases`. CartGenerator 0.5.1 will be offered this 0.5.2 hotfix after the assets and signed appcast are published.
